name: The Princess of Fire
source:
A mystical, haunting melody now wafts through the busy streets of Parcia, signaling the quiet arrival of a mysterious foreigner. Has he come to fulfill a terrible prophecy? Or to escape the chains of fate that bind him?

[Edited from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241201210458/https://renai.us/game/PrinOfFire]Renai.us[/url]]
